notes: These eight sheets are references for Vera/Modal, not final runtime assets.
Do not crop, resize, slice, recolor, or otherwise promote reference-sheet pixels into runtime tiles.
After Vera/Modal generates final source art from these references, the deterministic compiler may slice/package that generated output for World Editor and Engine v1.
A runtime A5 manifest must not be banked until Vera/Modal-generated source art exists and the compiled 384x768 RGBA sheet has a verified SHA-256.
